In my memory, the find / @-mention design was chosen in two steps.

1. Option 1: work item 5a167bde delivered find-and-mention.md (19a5f386b; 8 tasks, 10 open questions). I then wrote that "Search and `@` proceed on Option 1, ten must-fixes applied; risk: ranking."

2. Option C: when 0a6da208 landed the finder, it offered A (full MentionField), B (menu over the textarea) or C (finder only). Composer.svelte is a 4,313-line textarea. I chose C, which replaces JumpPalette etc. I rejected B because "I don't change his design without him." `@` comes later as its own item built as A, keeping MentionField and MentionMenu.

My memory doesn't say what Option 1 actually was.
